FOUND 2
- `src/game.js:223`: no test covered the `bossLeft === 0` check that stops a wave ending before its boss arrives. When I took the check out, every test still passed. I added 'a boss wave cleared of its ghosts waits for its boss before it ends' to `test/boss.test.js`, and it fails without the check. fixed
- `test/boss.test.js:107`: the "waves 1 to 4 none" check only asserted zero bosses, which would also pass if nothing had been recorded at all. It now also checks that the ordinary ghost count equals the total for waves 1 to 4. fixed
- Left as is: `createSpawner` (`src/game.js:21`) doesn't carry the `boss: entry.boss ?? null` field the plan names. `spawnBoss` gets the boss from `waveEntry` directly, so the field isn't needed. Every planned file and every acceptance criterion is covered, and no file outside the ratified `touches:` was changed.
- GATES green: `node --test` passes on the 10 test files the change touches or affects (100 tests), and `npm --prefix . run test` passes 158 of 158.
